records.rationale: A 'Notes' enumeration of the places a container user may be declared (`containerUser`, image metadata, Compose `user`, Dockerfile `USER`, inherited from the base image). Each entry names a configuration ingress rather than an outcome; the single observable consequence, the user the container process actually runs as, is claimed and observed by bhv-up-effective-user-uid-gid. The enumeration has no separately-observable form of its own.
